page_title: CHE 2-0 TOT | Chelsea v Tottenham Hotspur 02/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
90+6' James Maddison (Tottenham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+4' Here's the change. Nicolas Jackson leaves the pitch and Jimi Tauriainen (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
90+4' James Maddison (Tottenham) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
90+3' Excellent touch by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
90+2' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+1' James Maddison (Tottenham) picks up the rebound on the edge of the box and shoots. His effort, however, only finds the gloves of the opponent's goalkeeper. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the bottom left corner, but Djordje Petrovic is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
88' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
87' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Guglielmo Vicario to dive and make a save. Chelsea earn a corner.
86' Robert Jones couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) and blew his whistle. Chelsea win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
86' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Emerson Royal is replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alfie Gilchrist leaves the pitch and Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) comes on.
82' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
78' Here is a change. Brennan Johnson is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Bryan Gil (Tottenham).
77' James Maddison (Tottenham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Cesare Casadei (Chelsea) is replacing Mykhailo Mudryk.
75' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
72' 2 - 0 Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 2:0.
72' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes a mid-range free kick and his stunning strike crashes against the crossbar.
72' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Jones blows for a foul. Chelsea are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
70' The foul by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was seen by Robert Jones who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
69' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) plays a through ball but overhits it.
67' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
67' James Maddison (Tottenham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
64' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the bottom right corner and Djordje Petrovic easily makes the save.
63' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) replacing Yves Bissouma.
63' Pape Matar Sarr comes off the pitch to be replaced by James Maddison (Tottenham).
63' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) replaces Richarlison.
63' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.

62' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
61' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) commits a foul and Robert Jones immediately signals a free kick.
60' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
58' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) offside.
54' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
53' Noni Madueke passes to Cole Palmer (Chelsea), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
51' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
51' Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Robert Jones signals. Tottenham have a free kick from a promising distance.
48' Tottenham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
47' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
47' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
45+3' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Djordje Petrovic saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.
45+3' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) works the corner short.

45+2' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
43' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Tottenham get a corner.
42' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
39' Pedro Porro floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just wide of the left post from close in.
38' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Tottenham earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
35' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
32' Cole Palmer sends a slide-rule pass into the feet of Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea), who without a second thought fires a shot in on goal from mid-range which only goes just wide of the right post.
30' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
27' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Robert Jones to decide. The relieved Chelsea players can finally celebrate.
25' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Chelsea players aren’t happy.

24' 1 - 0 Goal! Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Conor Gallagher, and he steers a powerful header from the centre of the box inside the right post. What a finish that is - 1:0!
23' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.

21' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
21' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
20' Referee Robert Jones sees the trip by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Chelsea in a dangerous position.
18' A pass from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is intercepted by Djordje Petrovic and the move breaks down.
17' Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
14' The corner from Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is intercepted by the defence.
14' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
13' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
13' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Jones interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Chelsea earn a free kick.
10' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
7' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
6' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
4' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
2' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Chelsea will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Robert Jones.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
